derived_from: example_workflows/VoxCPM2-example.json plus the VoxCPM2_Clone schema at the pinned node commit

substitutions.notes: uploaded input path relative to the ComfyUI input directory
reference transcript; enables ultimate cloning on VoxCPM2
style control; ignored by the node when a transcript is provided

safety.notes: The node resolves models/tts/VoxCPM/VoxCPM2 before falling back to snapshot_download; the local checkout must exist so no weights are fetched. enable_asr stays false so the SenseVoice ASR model is never downloaded. force_offload=false retains the model between narration chunks; Studio releases it once after the narration job when unload_after is enabled.
